item.title: Bearer of Bad News
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: -It is a British man garbed in black who appears to seemingly random people, with the intention of giving bad news.
-It has the ability to teleport, but only when out of the line of sight of any individual.
-How it chooses who it will appear to and how it attains knowledge of the unfortunate future is unknown

Central Narrative: The story will be told mostly through interview and surveillance logs

Additional Notes: I haven't found anything on the site that has the same concept, but I wouldn't be surprised if there was one.
